description: On a new MDB database, ADO (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0) creates D(ID INTEGER primary key, N DECIMAL(28,0), S DECIMAL(18,4)). Seven rows are written by DAO Database.Execute of INSERT statements with the values as SQL numeric literals: N = 7, 4294967296, 4294967301, 18446744073709551621, 79228162514264337593543950335, -7, 0; S = 1.5, 0.0001, -2.5, 12345678901234.5678, 0, -0.0001, 3.125. Then, after closing and reopening, asks what DAO Field.Value, SQL CStr(N), CStr(S) and CDbl(N), DAO equality and range filters on N and S, SUM/MAX/MIN of N, ADO Field.Value and ADO GetRows return for those rows.
